25.2.5. Topology Checker Plugin — QGIS Documentation documentation
https://docs.qgis.org/3.40/en/docs/user_manual/plugins/core_plugins/plugins_topology_checker.html
Publisher: QGIS Project
Sections: User Manual §25.2.5, polygon rules and error validation
Rights: GNU Free Documentation License 1.3 or later; short research excerpts with attribution; see QGIS licensing snapshot.
Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
Must not overlap : Adjacent polygons should not share common area.
Validate All : applies the active rules to all the features of the involved layer(s)
Errors will show up in the table of results containing type of error, layer and feature ID.
where you can use QGIS digitizing tools to fix the error.
